Change Rational: A WASP application shall be able to setup a phone call connection and a video chat connection using the 3G Platform via the WASP platform. Add video call and chat functionality.
old_text: A WASP application shall be able to setup a phone call connection using the 3G Platform via the WASP platform.
new_text: A WASP application shall be able to setup a phone call connection and a video chat connection using the 3G Platform via the WASP platform.
annotation_note: Adds video chat to the phone-call requirement R26.

Change Rational: The platform must be able to store POI and service profiles. Remove service profile functionality.
old_text: The platform must be able to store POI and service profiles.
new_text: The platform must be able to store POI profiles.
annotation_note: Removes the 'service profile' part of R67 (rationale: 'Remove service profile functionality').

Change Rational: The WASP platform MUST be able to show the location of users on a map by marking them with a circle.
old_text: The WASP platform must be able to show the location of users on a map.
new_text: The WASP platform must be able to show the location of users on a map by marking them with a circle.
annotation_note: Adds 'marking them with a circle' to R42.

Change Rational: The WASP platform SHOULD be possible to determine the location of touristic attractions. Deviate from the calculated route to visit an attraction.
old_text: The WASP platform should be possible to determine the location of touristic attractions close to a calculated route.
new_text: The WASP platform should be possible to determine the location of touristic attractions.
annotation_note: Drops 'close to a calculated route' from R51 (user may deviate from the route).

Change Rational: Point of interest (POI) functionality is removed.
old_text: The WASP platform shall provide functionality to find points of interest that match the user's explicit need and obey the restrictions following from the user's profile and current context.
annotation_note: Whole POI feature removed; the main POI requirement R16 is deleted entirely.

Change Rational: When changes are discovered in the status of a user's buddy, the WASP platform must sent out notifications according to the alerts set by the user (see also REQ_NOT_006). Remove functionality to track the location of users.
old_text: When changes are discovered in the status and/or location of a user's buddy, the WASP platform must sent out notifications according to the alerts set by the user (see also REQ_NOT_006).
new_text: When changes are discovered in the status of a user's buddy, the WASP platform must sent out notifications according to the alerts set by the user (see also REQ_NOT_006).
annotation_note: Removes 'and/or location' from R25 (rationale: remove location tracking). This change was MISSING from the old changes.json.
